appDescription: An in-car companion app that helps drivers and passengers during a trip.

function.name: GET_TRIP_SUMMARY
function.description: Get a short summary of the current trip, such as distance driven and time elapsed.

function.name: SET_ALERT_LEVEL
function.description: Change how often the app gives spoken alerts while driving.

level.description: How often spoken alerts are given.

function.name: OPEN_TRIP_DETAIL
function.description: Open the detail screen of a past trip that matches the given date.

date.description: Date of the trip in ISO 8601 date format.
